subject: Cloudstride x AWS x SI Works: joint marketplace co-sell demo - slot proposal
messages:
From: Nadia Singh <nadia@cloudstride.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@siworks.co>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Joint demo: Cloudstride + SI Works + Redwood (marketplace focus)

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for agreeing to partner on a joint co-sell demo focused on the AWS Marketplace listing and SI integration. We want to make sure the marketplace flow (seller listing -> procurement -> private offers) is shown end-to-end alongside the SI technical walkthrough.

High-level ask: can we lock a 45-minute slot in the next week for the customer facing demo, plus a 30-minute dry-run the day before?

Proposed slots (all TZs shown for convenience):
- Option A: Mon 26 Apr 2027 10:00-10:45 PT / 13:00-13:45 ET / 18:00-18:45 BST
- Option B: Tue 27 Apr 2027 15:00-15:45 PT / 18:00-18:45 ET / 23:00-23:45 BST
- Option C: Wed 28 Apr 2027 08:00-08:45 PT (short morning window)
- Option D: Thu 29 Apr 2027 16:00-16:45 PT (late afternoon some of our EMEA folks can join)

Attachments: draft co-sell runbook (co-sell-runbook-draft.pdf) and a basic agenda.

Participants from our side: Nadia Singh (Cloudstride, Product), Alex Porter (SI Works, Solutions Architect).

If you can share Redwood preferred slots and any hard constraints (demo env region, required artifacts), we can confirm with AWS PM and the customer.

Cheers,
Nadia

--
Nadia Singh
Product Partnerships, Cloudstride
nadia@cloudstride.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: co-sell-runbook-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 384 KB); demo-agenda-azure-gcp-aws.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28 KB)

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Singh <nadia@cloudstride.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint demo: Cloudstride + SI Works + Redwood (marketplace focus)

Hi Nadia — thanks for the note and the runbook. We're excited to join. A few quick comments and constraints from Redwood:

- Our demo engineer (Sergio) is only available in later mornings PT; we generally prefer 10:00-13:00 PT for customer-facing runs.
- We should run the demo in an AWS us-west-2 region instance to match the marketplace listing you referenced — please confirm the listing is in us-west-2.
- We prefer a 40-minute demo + 20-minute Q&A (total 60), but happy to compress if the customer wants a shorter window.

Of your options above, Option A (Mon 26 Apr 10:00 PT) works best for us. If the AWS PM can confirm availability for both the demo and a dry-run (day before), we can lock the invite.

I'll loop in Sergio and Aditya to confirm technical prep and to propose a dry-run time. I've attached a short agenda template (demo-agenda-azure-gcp-aws.xlsx) with suggested section owners.

Laura
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Quick technical note from the infra side — please see below and a short preflight checklist attached.

- Demo env: happy to use us-west-2. We need the exact AWS account ID and the marketplace listing ARN so we can pre-authorize access and snapshot the demo account.
- Session length: to avoid token limits on long streaming walkthroughs, recommend 35-40 minutes of live demo + 20 min Q&A.
- Network: we'll do the demo from a studio VM behind our firewall; if the SI or customer needs to hit a private endpoint, we need the IP allowlist (I can share our expected outbound IPs once hosted).
- Dry-run: I can do a technical dry-run on Sun 25 Apr at 09:00 PT (that is 16:00 UTC) if that works for the SI and AWS PM.

I'm attaching preflight-checklist.txt with the items I need checked prior to the dry-run.

Sergio
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Hi all,

Thanks for the details. AWS Marketplace can join — proposed confirmed schedule below:

- Dry-run (technical): Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT (30 minutes)
- Customer-facing demo (final): Mon, 26 Apr 2027 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT (45 minutes)

I've reviewed the runbook; two asks before dry-run:
1) Please share the marketplace listing ARN and the AWS account ID that will be used for procurement testing.
2) Send an attendee list with titles and emails so we can create a private offer flow for the demo customer.

Also sharing our doc for marketplace test flows: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/test-flow-guides (see section on private offers).

I'll put a tentative calendar hold and send a DocuSign PO form link if the customer wants to exercise procurement during the demo.

Best,
